objective: Diagnosticar en solo lectura los folios cerrados de ORIGEN MPRO del 2026-10-02 que deben aparecer junto con los abiertos en el detalle de ventas del dia. Comparar fuente canonica Venta_Encabezado y fuente provisional Comanda. No tocar Produccion.

queries.name: origen_closed_canonical_today
queries.sql: SELECT ve.Vn_Documento AS folio, SUM(ISNULL(ve.Vn_Precio_Neto_Importe,0)) AS total_ticket, COUNT(*) AS headers FROM Venta_Encabezado ve WHERE ve.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND CAST(ve.Vn_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND ve.Es_Cve_Estado IN ('AC','FA') AND ve.Fecha_Baja IS NULL GROUP BY ve.Vn_Documento ORDER BY ve.Vn_Documento

queries.name: origen_closed_provisional_today
queries.sql: SELECT c.Co_Folio AS folio, SUM(ISNULL(cd.Cd_Importe,0)) AS total_ticket, MAX(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,0)) AS pax FROM Comanda c INNER JOIN Comanda_Detalle cd ON cd.Co_Folio=c.Co_Folio WHERE CAST(c.Co_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND c.Es_Cve_Estado='PA' AND cd.Es_Cve_Estado='AC' AND cd.Fecha_Baja IS NULL GROUP BY c.Co_Folio ORDER BY c.Co_Folio

queries.name: origen_all_comanda_status_today
queries.sql: SELECT c.Co_Folio AS folio, c.Es_Cve_Estado AS estado, MAX(ISNULL(c.Co_Personas,0)) AS pax, SUM(ISNULL(cd.Cd_Importe,0)) AS total_detalle FROM Comanda c LEFT JOIN Comanda_Detalle cd ON cd.Co_Folio=c.Co_Folio AND cd.Es_Cve_Estado='AC' AND cd.Fecha_Baja IS NULL WHERE CAST(c.Co_Fecha AS date)='2026-10-02' AND c.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' GROUP BY c.Co_Folio,c.Es_Cve_Estado ORDER BY c.Co_Folio
